notes.title: The Levels & Leeks Update
notes.content:
It’s a beautiful day to celebrate fiber intake in the monastery!

In version 1118, we’re serving you a plate of cold, raw vegetables as well as new levels at a more pleasant temperature. Possibly texture as well, we haven’t tried eating the walls. Yet.

Here’s the full patch notes:



Added four new levels to chapters 1, 3 and 4! 

These levels are also present in Endless Mode

Added three vegetables to the game: Cabbages, Leeks and Turnips!

Major performance improvements for visual effects

Fixed a crash related to voice chat

Hopefully 🤞 fixed an issue where certain NPCs would exist on clients but *not* on the server 



Are you looking for more MEAT? We’ll have something pretty beefy for you in the next one. Stay tuned!

Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking can be picked up for $7.99 USD:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]
See you in the monastery,

- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Crashing into view is v.1117 - the Molotovs & Tamed Rats update.
notes.content:
Hello, my monks!



I recall asking you whether you were feeling quite flame-y enough.



Well, I hope you weren't, because we've introduced more exciting sources of fires in this one. 



On an additional serious note: we also greatly modified the behavior of rats.

Yes, we called upon the professional rat tamers that we have connections with and they taught the rats proper theft etiquette.

We heard folks loud and clear on this one - rats were a bit punishing and we respect the feedback.


Among a host of other taming modifications, rats will now specifically only target items currently held in the player's hand, meaning you should be able to better prepare yourself to respond to their presence accordingly. 



Here are the full patch notes for the Molotovs & Tamed Rats update:

Added four new items: Mimic Food, Cross Grenade, Molotovs and the Invulnerability Cross!

Mimic Food behaves like a regular food item but, when picked up, turns into... something else

Improved the behavior of rats. They're not quite model citizens, but they're much better

Removed an old unused tooltip

Lots of tweaks and fixes across many levels!





You can grab Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking for $7.99 USD.   [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]

 

See you in the monastery,


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Hotfix (v.1115)
notes.content:
Good afternoon, monks!



We had some reports that some of you were experiencing an issue with the countdown timer starting. Fortunately, we were able to fix that quickly!



Fixed an issue where the countdown timer would not start upon starting a game round

Fixed an issue where players could get poisoned when entering the larder ☠️



As always, thank you so much for sending along your feedback and reports.

If you find anything else to report, be sure to let us know!



Back to the larder,


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Introducing ENDLESS MODE to Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking!
notes.content:
Hello monks, monks-to-be, monk-adjacents, perhaps kaiju, a passing crow, whoever else you may be: 

In this historically accurate stew, we've got ENDLESS MODE. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702297/0d66af1a562a665fed24b6c8699c50da8721ea79.png"]


Now when you host a lobby, you can select "Endless Mode" as an option.

By doing so, you will initiate a game mode where players enter larder levels at random with ONE goal:

Earn as many points as possible. Also, survive.



Yet don't get too comfortable in survival, my little monks, as the conditions only get more treacherous the longer you go.



Here are the full patch notes for version 1114:

We added Endless Mode!

Endless Mode can be selected in the Host Lobby menu (it's a special chapter which may load any level from the entire game)

After each level, players are taken back to the Monastery to buy new items from the monks. Their stores are randomized

Also, feeding the Kaiju gets progressively harder after each level. Good luck!!

Improved some audio effects

Level tweaks and fixes

Fixed an issue where the HUD would not always turn green upon successfully feeding the Kaiju. 

Fixed an issue where the Broom would not work correctly on clients

Fixed frozen enemies in the larder



Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking is available to play solo, with strange monks from across the internet, or with a group of hand-selected bold friends for $7.99 USD:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]
See you in the place that never ends (or you know, perhaps Discord),


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Changelog for ver. 1113: the New Levels Update!
notes.content:
Hello, little monks!

It's not too big of a list this time aside from the new levels - we're working on cooking something quite big to share with you soon.

In the meantime, here are the notes for version 1113:

Two new levels got added to Chapters 2 & 4! (2 new levels for Chapter 2 + another 2 new levels for Chapter 4)

Many fixes were implemented for other levels

Fixed an issue where only the server could push things with the broom

Fixed an issue where spice falls were not being replicated correctly

Fixed an issue where Will O' Wisps would appear to be stuck in place for players other than the host


We'll talk again real soon,


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Welcome to v. 1111, a.k.a the GET SOME SPACE update. 🧹
notes.content:
Hello hello!

I'm back with another round of fun post-launch updates.

This time, WE'VE GOT TOOLS FOR YA.

Were you not feeling enough wind in your little monk sails last time?

Not feeling quite flame-y enough?

Well, that's very specific of you, but I have great news.

You're gonna get a dang broom. You're gonna get a flaming crossbow. And you know what? You're gonna get.. potentially even more sources of fire in this update. Because we care about you and your health.



Here are the full patch notes for the Get Some Space update:

Added a Fire Crossbow. Y'know, for setting things on fire

Added a Knockback Broom. Y'know, for knocking things back

Added a Pack of Candles. Y'know, for flashbanging your foes (the team tells me this is what candles are apparently for)

Useful level modifications happened

Fixed an issue where shadows would be cast from the chat bubbles above players' heads

Fixed an issue where oil would make the host slippery but not other players (😳)

Improved Steam Deck support with new default graphics settings and a new default Steam Input map!

Added AMD FSR3 as an anti-aliasing option! This can be paired with the render scale setting to greatly improve performance on weaker computers

Added the new tools to all shops

Improved the tutorial messages for players on the Steam Deck

Fixed an issue where spicefalls wouldn't have their intended spice effect

Fixed an issue with apples and oranges. Again, lol

Fall damage now takes the player's velocity into consideration





When I grabbed this list from the programmers, I found a scribbled note that just says "use knockback brooms to rocket jump." What on earth did they mean by that??? Hello?



You can grab Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking for $7.99 USD!
  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]

Please sweep responsibly. 


See you in the monastery (with even more updates soon),


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: It's v. 1106, the Chant Voice Customization Update!
notes.content:
Hi folks!


In our first really fun round of post-launch updates, I'm excited to announce that we have now implemented chant voices that you can select from.

This is 100% so that you can truly feel in-tune with your monk as you play and absolutely not so you can haunt both your friends and the NPCs.



Here are the full patch notes:

Voice chat has been reworked - you should expect improved audio quality now!

You can now change microphones for voice chat 

Players can now customize their chant voice!

There's now a voice chat icon on top of players that are talking

Fixed the hold zones for pies & cheese items on both monks and rats

Fixed an issue where joining a server too late would cause clients to see incorrect spicefall particles



As a reminder, you'll currently find Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD) 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]
Please chant responsibly.



See you in the monastery (with even more updates soon),


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Resolution for Crashing Issues in Newest Game Version: vers. 1104
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We were recently made aware of crashes affecting folks starting the game after we tried to rectify a different issue involving crashes when enabling Windowed mode. We have since addressed both issues.

If you're still crashing from an earlier save, you should be able to delete that save folder and continue playing.

Please let us know if anything else comes up and we'll hop to it!


As a reminder, you'll currently find Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD) [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3139570/announcements/detail/539986220231435188"][/dynamiclink]
Thanks again for all of your prompt feedback & reports - keep em coming.

We'll be back with you soon to start chatting about all the updates we've got in store.

Let's just say, I hope you REALLY like chanting.


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Changelog for Release: ver. 1103
notes.content:
Happy launch day, monks!

To celebrate launch, you'll find Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD)
[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3139570/announcements/detail/539986220231435188"][/dynamiclink]
Below, you'll also find our first release changelog, officially bridging the playtest to our launch.

We want to thank you all so much for playing with us over the last week as well as leaving us all of your reports + feedback. It's been immensely helpful, and the team has been actively working to address your reports.

Here are the notes for version 1103:



Visual effects have been optimized

Reducing the graphics settings should now hide some smaller effects

Fixed an issue where rats would not drop their items upon death (they were dedicated)

All item vendors in the Monastery had their inventories tweaked

Added a dynamic difficulty system that adjusts certain parameters of the game according to the amount of players in the match

Improved controller support for the player kick screen

Fixed an issue where certain items would have their names displayed with ALL CAPS

Going back to the Monastery after a successful match will now erase the inventory of all players (sorry!!)

 Fixed an issue where certain visual effects would vanish from the player's screen if the player moved their camera fast enough

Added a visual effect for when the Minotaur charges into a wall (it's very good and funny)

Adjusted the knockback of the Wooden Cross on Evil Spirits

Plenty of text changes

Added a Credits screen

Fixed an issue with Pascal's beard (sorry bud)

Improved item throwing

The game's timer will now start with exactly 10 minutes

After dying, NPCs will now fade out faster

Chanting had its stamina consumption halved

The Rolling Pin's cooldown has been reduced to match the Cleaver's cooldown.

The Big Rock now deals a lot more damage, can now be used to crush ingredients

Upon satisfying the Kaiju, the HUD's timer will correctly display one minute left for players to bring all treasure to the lift

The Minotaur can no longer steer during a charge after hitting at least one character

Also, the Minotaur can only deal damage after 1 second has passed since it started charging.

Added an option to anonymize player names (we're hoping this makes footage & streaming feel much more accessible!)

Clicking twice on the same lobby in the lobby selection panel should no longer display the "Stuff's on fire!" message.

The Crossbow is no longer a large item

If all players die after the Kaiju has been fed, the victory screen shows up instantly instead of only after 1 minute

Fixed an issue where the Seasoning Portals could have incorrect effects

Successfully feeding the Kaiju will now display a message on the Event Log on the upper right corner of the screen



We'd love to emphasize again: If you still experience crashes after updating, please try running the game with DirectX 11!

Have a great week,


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: New List, Same Great Flavor of Patch Notes: ver. 1069
notes.content:
Good evening, my monks!

Let's jump right in with the most recent batch of patch notes for the latest version 1069:



Fixed an issue where failing a level would cause the chapter to progress anyway

The Monastery Lift now tells players how many players are in the match and how many are standing on the lift.

You can now listen to yourself when talking on a voice tube (delightful)

A bunch of updates to the Monastery!

Fixed dialogue lines in various years

Fixed an issue with collision volumes in the lake

Various VOIP modifications and fixes

Updated all shops in the game

Even more improved controller support

Removed the tutorial sheet from the player's starting loadout



We'd love to emphasize again: If you still experience crashes after updating, please try running the game with DirectX 11! 

Thanks again for continuing to share all of your feedback with us, it's immensely helpful.

Have a great weekend in the monastery!


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Patch Notes: ver. 1048
notes.content:
Guess what I'm back with?

Another round of patch notes!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702297/065bb1dcc0ca360ca0329d0f8bc2bc6fe8c0a183.png"]
The team has been hard at work this week responding to your feedback. We greatly appreciate the reception - it helps immensely.



Here's the batch of notes for ver. 1048:



After winning, players can return to the monastery early by standing on the lift and chanting

Players no longer spawn with the cleaver. (Look around in the monastery!)

Intro sequence will now only play once on startup

Returning from invisibility no longer shows your whole inventory in your hand

The minotaur's homing capabilities have been reduced

Improved performance for low-end hardware on the lake

NPCs no longer receive decals

Improved main menu controller support

A bunch of monastery changes across multiple years

Added a lobby menu! 

Added lobby kicking! 

No more item duping. sorry

"Time Running Out" BGM should now stop when the game is over/player quits the lobby

Monastery set dressing updates

Waterfalls now have small splash effects

Fixed an issue with extended crushers (and lifts)

Plenty of level changes/tweaks

The lake lift no longer rises. Instead, it'll start already at its final position

Something mysterious has happened to Alric

Fixed the materials of some props in order to increase their roughness.

(Hopefully) fixed an issue where voice chat would stop working after roughly a minute.

You can no longer scroll through items while paused.

In general, more improved controller support!





 If you still experience crashes after updating, please try running the game with DirectX 11! 

As always, we welcome you to continue sharing your feedback and reports with us as well.

Let's get back to cooking!


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Patch Notes: ver. 1037
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's been a blast seeing you all have fun with the Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking Playtest this past week.

Our team would love to make known our recent batch of notes for ver. 1037!


Let's dive right in.

Fixed various dialogue issues & bugs

Ambient sounds have been reworked

Monastery fixes

Renamed a few items and modified some reminders

Various tweaks to the player burning VFX

(↑ being on fire is no longer blinding 🧯👁️)

Fixed an issue where pressing the Back button on a gamepad would cause a developer panel to show up

HUD updates

Restored collision to the voice tubes

Fixed an issue with lobby player counts

Added more options to the options menu, including: inverted controls, FOV sliders, screen resolutions and other adjustments

Reduced the range of Ghoul attacks

Players should no longer clip through elevators

Rats are easier to hit now (go get your revenge)

Fixed an issue where pressing Tab could lock a player in place & focus an invisible HUD element

(We're hoping 🤞) we fixed an issue where changing screen resolutions would cause the game to crash

Fixed an issue where player customization would sometimes not save correctly

Many, many level fixes

Fixed an issue where lobbies wouldn't show up on the list. (This has ALSO fixed another issue where lobby inviting wouldn't work!)

Lobby data should be more accurate now

Players who had toggled 'full screen' and were crashing should no longer crash

Steam will now ask players to choose between DX12 and DX11! (Try DX11 if you're having crash issues)

Game should no longer crash upon beating a chapter

VOIP issues should now be fixed

Added a post-chapter victory panel for when players complete an entire chapter,

Players can no longer duplicate items

Fixed an issue where players would not respawn correctly after the end of a match,

Added snapping to the mangonel / catapult



Additionally, achievements are now in! This won't be noticeable for playtesting purposes (sorry!!) but they'll be ready for launch in one week.



We're also investigating:

An issue where the player will hold their entire inventory at once after becoming visible again,

Solutions to reported performance issues. We've set up test environments on older hardware to better profile the causes of these issues,



.. as well as planning for the near future:

More Lobby Admin QoL adjustments,

Controller support,



 If you still experience crashes after updating, please try running the game with DirectX 11!

As always, thank you folks so much for sending along your feedback and reports.

If you find anything else to report, be sure to let us know!

See you in the monastery, 


- Christa @ Strange Scaffold

notes.title: Let's Play(test) Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking Together!
notes.content:
Welcome to the monastery.

We're excited to invite everyone to playtest Strange Scaffold's first co-op game:
Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking.



In this absurdist online multiplayer horror game, you and your friends must use traps, proximity voice chat and Gregorian chanting (among other tools) to feed giant monsters known as kaiju. Along the way, you'll gather treasure and ᵐᵃʸᵇᵉ prevent the apocalypse.

Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking's playtest is now open to everyone TODAY! This means you can play the full game and see its development hit completion in real-time leading up to its launch on July 29th.



[previewyoutube="JoyLrJ2deig;full"][/previewyoutube]


We want to emphasize: these are the final days of development on our first multiplayer game. This is not a demo or a beta. We're inviting you to join us on an exciting journey while we gear up for launch!

So if you enjoy your time cooking, give us a wishlist and tell a friend. ♡


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702297/065bb1dcc0ca360ca0329d0f8bc2bc6fe8c0a183.png"]

🍳 Christa @ Strange Scaffold
